name: comp-581
title: Minimal Auth Navbar
description: A dark site header with a logo, four plain nav links, and three round icon buttons on the right for help, notifications and the user menu; the bell opens a panel of recent updates.
use: A signed-in app needs a light header with quick access to help and notifications.
avoid: The notification list uses fixed sample names and timestamps, so it still needs wiring to real data.
a11y: The logo link has no accessible name, and labelling of the icon menus depends on the separate components used. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark header with a starburst logo, Home, Features, Pricing and About links, then three round icon buttons on the right: an info mark, a bell and a small avatar. Opening the bell reveals a rounded panel with a title, a Mark all as read link and a list of updates.
behaves: The info icon opens a short help menu and the bell opens a notifications panel listing review, sharing and assignment updates with timestamps. Each panel closes when the pointer leaves or focus moves away.
customise: Nav labels are set in the file; the info, notification and user menus come from separate pieces whose contents you edit there.
weight: light: A row of links, three small buttons and one open panel.
